create schema if not exists push_relay;

create table push_relay.handles (
  handle text primary key,
  kind text not null check (kind in ('apns', 'fcm')),
  token text not null,
  environment text check (environment in ('sandbox', 'production')),
  origin text not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null,
  unique (token, origin),
  check ((kind = 'apns') = (environment is not null))
);

create table push_relay.credentials (
  id uuid primary key,
  origin text not null,
  secret_hash bytea not null check (octet_length(secret_hash) = 32),
  created_at timestamptz not null,
  hour timestamptz,
  sent integer check (sent >= 0)
);

insert into push_relay.handles (handle, kind, token, environment, origin, created_at)
      values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, now())
      on conflict (token, origin) do update set kind = excluded.kind, environment = excluded.environment
      returning handle

      values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, now())
      on conflict (token, origin) do update set kind = excluded.kind, environment = excluded.environment
      returning handle

      values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, now())
      on conflict (token, origin) do update set kind = excluded.kind, environment = excluded.environment
      returning handle
insert into push_relay.credentials (id, origin, secret_hash, created_at) values ($1::uuid, $2, $3, now())
select id, origin, secret_hash from push_relay.credentials where id = $1::uuid

update push_relay.credentials
      set sent = case when hour >= $1::timestamptz then sent + $2 else $3 end, hour = greatest(hour, $4::timestamptz)
      where id = $5::uuid and (case when hour >= $6::timestamptz then sent + $7 else $8 end) <= $9
      returning id
